title: A cover-led library
question: Choose the reading gallery, steer the direction, or ask for a fresh set. This covers My library, Archive, and Collections.

options.label: The reading gallery
options.thesis: Your books form a quiet exhibition, grouped by where you are in your reading.
options.viewport: A generous library title, compact tab navigation, and a ruled Reading heading above an evenly spaced cover wall.
options.risk: More restrained than a playful bookshelf; covers must carry its character.

raised.raise: Strong grouping without floating card containers.
Every section earns its space with actual content.
Whole cover cells reflow cleanly at every width.
Clear anchors orient readers in long collections.
Unambiguous active navigation and repeated section cues.
